test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states does NOT share land boundary with Nepal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jharkhand** does not share land boundary with Nepal.
 
• Nepal shares a border of about **1850 km** with five Indian States - Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal and Sikkim.
 
• An estimated** 6 million **Nepalese live and work in India.
 
• The India–Nepal border is an open international border running between** India and Nepal.**
 
• The **1,770 km** (1,099.83 mi) long border includes the Himalayan territories as well as Indo-Gangetic Plain.
 
• The current border was delimited after the **Sugauli treaty** of 1816 between Nepal and the British Raj.
 
• Following Indian independence, the current border was recognised as the border between **Nepal and the Republic of India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hemant Soren** is an Indian politician from Jharkhand, who is currently the Chief Minister of Jharkhand.
 
• **Ranchi,** in its modern form, is the capital city of the Indian state of Jharkhand.
 
• The present governor of Jharkhand is **Ramesh Bais**.
 
• **Indian Elephant** is the state animal of Jharkhand.
